exact_intended_prompt:
You are a fresh independent final-only source auditor for the Ark Nova original English base-game rules summary. Read ONLY the exact candidate snapshot at /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/ark-nova/2026-11-04-batch-231507/expanded-iteration-19/summary-snapshot.md, the neutral identity/hash manifest at /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/ark-nova/2026-11-04-batch-231507/neutral-source-manifest.json, and the seven raw source files explicitly identified by that manifest. Original base scope includes the English main v1.2, base glossary, official base FAQ and official base Icon Overview; optional solo, expansions, promos, map packs and strategy guide are excluded. Original publisher German component photographs are supplementary diagrams for original component numerals only; English prose controls.

Do not read canonical or any other summary version, earlier audit or review, findings, repair history, question bank, keys, reader prompts, answers, grades, coverage maps, status, report or parent history. Do not browse or contact another agent. Do not infer expected findings from file/directory names.

Independently verify accuracy AND procedural completeness of the whole supplied summary against the whole accepted source packet. Check setup, ordinary actions and timing, tracks, break, endgame, exceptions, glossary/icon procedures and printed reference details, including evidence visible only in diagrams. Distinguish source-observable data from obscured or unreadable data; never invent hidden values. Do not demand strategy advice or excluded modes. Report unsupported claims, contradictions, omissions and any actual uncertainty with precise source and summary citations. Do not treat a matching hash as a complete read.

Read all summary and raw text in bounded complete chunks; recover every truncated range before concluding. Count logical lines using splitlines and inspect true EOF, including a possible final unterminated line. Enumerate every PDF page and inspect all page images as well as text, then inspect both original component photos. You may use /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/.venv/bin/python with PyMuPDF to extract/render the allowed PDF files into /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/ark-nova/2026-11-04-batch-231507/final-source-audit-03; those derivative assets remain allowed inputs. Use tools.view_image to inspect local images. Do not read other repo files or network URLs.

Write ONLY within /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/ark-nova/2026-11-04-batch-231507/final-source-audit-03. Save report.json containing exact intended prompt, all allowed input identities/hashes, actual complete-read ranges and truncation recovery, PDF page/image inspection evidence and both photo inspections, a claim/source audit or coverage ledger, all findings with severity and concrete support, unresolved material/minor counts, and PASS/FAIL with exact snapshot SHA256. Save any necessary source-only derived extraction/render files there. Read-only inputs must remain unchanged. A PASS requires no unresolved material error or credible minor rules omission in scope. Return a concise verdict and report path.
